Usage: phoenix-ui install [options]

Install compiled Phoenix UI skills into project or user-level harness folders.
A project install overwrites the Phoenix tool files and replaces only the
Phoenix entries in shared hook configuration; rerun it to repair.

Options:
  --providers=<names>    Comma-separated harnesses to install
  --project [<dir>]      Install into the current or given project (default)
  --user, --global       Install at the user level (also --scope=global)
  -y, --yes              User level: accept detected defaults without prompting
  --no-hooks             User level: install skills without provider hook manifests
  --force                User level: replace an existing installation
  --dry-run              Project: report the plan without writing
  --bundle-root=<path>   Explicit local bundle; also PHOENIX_UI_BUNDLE_PATH
  --json                 Project: report as one JSON object
  -h, --help             Show this help message
